apps.name: PhotoSwiper
apps.subtitle: Swipe your camera roll
apps.localizedDescription: Tinder-style photo curation. Swipe left = delete, right = save to Immich, up = share to the other person via Messages.
apps.versionDescription: Phase 2.1: photo browsing + permission prompt on first launch. Swipe actions are still placeholders (Phase 3 wires real actions).

versions.localizedDescription: Phase 2.1: photo browsing + first-launch permission prompt. Swipe through your camera roll in random or oldest-first order. Swipe actions are placeholders (no delete/upload/share yet — Phase 3).

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PhotoSwiper needs access to show and curate your photos.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save photos back to your library after editing.
